description: The Austrian hydrographic service (the water balance department of the federal ministry BMLUK, the hydrographic services of the Länder, viadonau and about 1,800 mostly private observers) produced eHYD, which gives long-term checked and current hydrological data on surface waters, groundwater and the atmosphere from several thousand stations. Coverage is Austria. The portal is free to view, and data can be taken only where a download is explicitly offered. Caveats: all other downloading from the site and its map services is expressly forbidden, and the ministry accepts no liability for completeness. Simulation uses: discharge and groundwater series for flood hazard, drought and water supply resource studies. Related records: Norway's NVE HydAPI (data-norway-nve-hydapi-hydrological-time-series).
